scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @snippet/contracts && npm run build --workspace @snippet/database && npm run build --workspace @snippet/api
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @snippet/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p packages/database/tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.check.json
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test:integration --workspace @snippet/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration --workspace @snippet/api
